safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state that the patient takes no regular medications.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient takes no regular medications can impair medication reconciliation and may lead clinicians to assume missing chronic therapies or overlook that symptoms are unlikely medication-related. While unlikely to directly change acute wheeze management, it can introduce avoidable confusion and follow-up work.
